roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse
description:
Join a premier skilled nursing facility in Oakland, MD, as a Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse. This critical role offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42, providing an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact on staff competency and patient safety. You will be instrumental in developing and implementing educational programs for our nursing staff and ensuring adherence to the highest standards of infection prevention and control.

We are seeking a dedicated and experienced nurse to lead our staff development initiatives and oversee our comprehensive infection control program. This is an urgent opening for a professional passionate about fostering a culture of continuous learning and maintaining a safe, healthy environment for both residents and staff.
requirements: Experience in staff development or nursing education
Experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations

roleTitle: Therapist (OT, PT, ST) / Therapy Assistant (COTA, PTA)
description:
We are seeking dedicated and skilled Occupational Therapists (OT), Physical Therapists (PT), Speech Therapists (ST), Certified Occupational Therapy Assistants (COTA), and Physical Therapist Assistants (PTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Ocala, FL. This is an excellent opportunity for professionals looking for flexible full-time or part-time positions where they can make a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being.

Join a supportive team environment focused on delivering high-quality care. We offer competitive compensation for both full-time and part-time roles, providing a rewarding career path for therapists and therapy assistants committed to excellence.
requirements: Valid state license/certification as an Occupational Therapist (OT), Physical Therapist (PT), Speech Therapist (ST), Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA), or Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA).
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting is preferred.
Ability to provide high-quality, patient-centered therapy services.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills for effective team collaboration.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rates ranging from $28.00 - $37.00 for COTA/PTA roles and $40.00 - $46.00 for OT/PT/ST roles, based on experience and qualifications.

description: Join a dedicated team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Ocala, FL, committed to providing exceptional patient care and rehabilitation services. We are seeking a passionate and skilled Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) to contribute to our mission of improving patient outcomes and quality of life.In this full-time role, you will work collaboratively with Physical Therapists to implement individualized treatment plans, assist patients in regaining mobility and function, and provide therapeutic exercises and modalities. Your expertise will be crucial in helping our residents achieve their rehabilitation goals in a supportive and dynamic environment.This is a full-time opportunity offering a competitive hourly rate. We value our team members and provide a supportive work environment where you can grow professionally.
requirements: Associate's degree from an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) program
Current and valid PTA license in the state of Florida
Previous experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $28.00 - $37.00, based on experience.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated Full-time Occupational Therapist (OT) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Ocala, FL. This critical role offers an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact on patients' lives, helping them regain independence and improve their quality of life through comprehensive therapy programs.

As an Occupational Therapist, you will be an integral part of a compassionate team, providing essential services in a supportive environment. This full-time position comes with a competitive hourly rate, reflecting the importance of your expertise and commitment to patient care.

If you are a skilled Occupational Therapist looking for a rewarding full-time opportunity with a focus on rehabilitation, we encourage you to apply and become a vital part of our team.
requirements: Master's or Doctorate degree in Occupational Therapy (OT)
Current state licensure as an Occupational Therapist in Florida
Experience in a rehabilitation or skilled nursing facility setting
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation for Full-time Occupational Therapists is $40.00 - $48.00 per hour.
